title: On the generalised ideal flow of closed planar curves
summary: For each integer $m\ge0$ we study the $m$-ideal energy \[ E_m[γ]:=\frac12\int_γk_{s^m}^2\,ds \] on closed immersed planar curves, where $k$ is signed curvature and $s$ is arclength; $k^2_{s^m} := (k_{s^m})^2$. The $m$-ideal energies contain Euler's elastic energy and the Dirichlet energy for the curvature scalar as special cases ($m=0,1$). We completely classify the closed smooth critical points of $E_m$ for all $m\ge1$: they are precisely the round multiply-covered circles.
